title: Six equivalent characterizations of geometric normality for a scheme over a field
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma collects six equivalent conditions for a scheme X over a field k: geometric normality, normality after every field extension, after every finitely generated extension, after every finite purely inseparable extension, geometric normality of the coordinate rings of affine opens, and normality after the perfect closure (statement lines 2159-2176). The proof runs the cycle of implications explicitly: (1) to (2) is by definition applied to local rings at points of the base change, the chain (2) to (3) to (4) is immediate, (4) to (5) translates the normality of the base changed affine opens into normality of the tensor products against all finite purely inseparable extensions and invokes the algebraic definition, and (5) to (1) uses that the base change is glued from the spectra of the tensor products of the coordinate rings (proof lines 2179-2201). The equivalence of the last two conditions then follows from the definition and the already proved equivalence of (3) and (4) (proof lines 2204-2206). The claim is H2: six conditions but a short cycle of implications, with the translation between the scheme statement and the algebra definition as the only step needing care.
